name: Kenna
self_text: Hi! I'm Kenna, an Egyptian in my mid 20s with a background in biology. When I'm not swing dancing, which I love for the energy and rhythm, I spend my time programming. I'm looking for someone to study independently side by side with me online. I'm available on Sunday afternoons or during weekday evenings. I'm happy with occasional short exchanges while we work, but I'm not looking for any tutoring either way.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into studying independently side by side, and it's a deal-breaker unless we overlap on online. It would be nice if you are okay with complete silence while working or occasional short exchanges. A small bonus if you are into statistics. Ideally, you are available Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings, but no big deal.
